channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Closing arguments set in trial over 2012 killing of UNC student
item.description: Closing arguments are expected Thursday in the trial of a man accused of killing a North Carolina college student 14 years ago.

item.title: Starlink and Starshield: Their Role in Ukraine
item.description: An overview of Starlink and Starshield, the technologies Ukraine depends on in its war with Russia.

item.title: Seven-Year-Old Street Singer Gains Social Media Following
item.description: ABC News' Danny New speaks with Jordan Sunshine, a California boy who found relief from anxiety by performing on Los Angeles streets.

item.title: U.S. Reduces Middle East Troop Presence, Sources Say
item.description: The U.S. military has quietly scaled back its presence at Middle East posts due to ongoing threats from Iran and its Houthi allies in Yemen, sources say.
